name: Pikopiko ~Hitokuchi Dake no Yuuki~
original_name: ぴこぴこ～ひとくちだけの勇気～
source: Hitokuchi Dake no Yuuki / A Single Bite of Courage is a very short story featuring the game's protagonist and Miko as they get ready to eat breakfast.
translation: 《Hitokuchi Dake no Yuuki》（《一口的勇氣》）是一則極短故事，講述遊戲主角和Miko準備吃早餐的情景。
